record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only masked-item cross-entropy temperature from 0.8 to 1.0. Softer training logits may reduce overconfident fitting and improve candidate ranking with the incumbent's normalized tied embeddings. This requires no auxiliary forward pass, avoiding the additional work of the previous timed-out pairwise objective. Preserve masked-target selection, sampling, topology, scoring/readout, optimizer and schedule; inference remains appended-mask scoring.
